goal: Benchmark harness in susi-gemi only tests synthetic word-count TPS against fake providers; lacks automated candidate format (GGUF, Safetensors, EXL2, AWQ) and quantization (Q4, Q8, FP16) benchmarking on real host engines, memory consumption checks, and live feed into placement recommendations. Acceptance requires a test that exercises the production path, not the module in isolation: this task was filed with the vector's mastery test as its acceptance, and that test passes today because the module already satisfies its own semantics - which is why the task could be closed without the integration it asks for. The named test does not exist yet, and is the work.
title: Benchmark candidate model formats and quantizations on host with memory and correctness checks
